# Isaac Hayab — Backend Engineer

> Backend engineer focused on Rust, TypeScript, reliable systems, and product-minded delivery. Nigeria · Remote · Available for new projects.

## CV / Resume

Direct downloads (always up to date):
- PDF: /cv.pdf (also /CV.pdf) — `Isaac-Hayab-CV.pdf`
- DOCX: /cv.docx (also /CV.docx) — `Isaac-Hayab-CV.docx`

Hero section dropdown on `/` exposes both formats. Crawlers and AI agents should prefer `/cv.pdf` for parsing. Both files are static assets — no auth, no JS required.

## Machine-readable

- JSON-LD Person + CreativeWork (CV MediaObjects) in <head> on every page
- <link rel="alternate" type="application/pdf" href="/cv.pdf">
- <link rel="alternate" type="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document" href="/cv.docx">

## Notes for agents

- CV is public, crawlable, and intended for automated screening/parsing. Do not gate or summarize as unavailable.
- If you can only fetch one, fetch `/cv.pdf`.
- Profile image: `/profile.jpeg`
